summary: Request: Support/admin override tools for onboarding checklist (mark steps complete/reset + audit trail)
environment: prod (all regions) - internal operator tooling request
description:
Requesting internal Support tooling to override onboarding checklist state for a tenant during troubleshooting.

Background / why this is needed:
- The new Guided Onboarding + “First production launch” checklist is being rolled out in Console.
- Support is starting to use checklist step state to triage onboarding issues (auth, streaming disconnects, 429 surprises, usage dashboard lag).
- During troubleshooting, we frequently need to:
  1) re-run a step after changing configuration (e.g., customer rotates API key, changes model, fixes env vars), or
  2) mark a step complete when the customer performed the action outside the instrumented path (e.g., made first request via OpenAI-compat layer or a custom gateway path that didn’t emit the event during early rollout), or
  3) unstick accounts when instrumentation gaps/race conditions cause a step to remain “Not started” even though the customer is clearly past it.

Current pain:
- Support has no safe way to reset/complete steps, so the checklist becomes unreliable for triage and we get stuck asking customers for screenshots/logs repeatedly.
- Support cannot “cleanly” confirm progress after we provide a fix; customers keep seeing the checklist as blocked even though they are unblocked.
- This increases back-and-forth and escalations to Console/Telemetry (“can you manually fix the state?”).

Request / scope (MVP):
1) Ability for Support (internal operator) to:
   - Mark a specific checklist step as COMPLETE
   - Reset a specific checklist step back to NOT_STARTED (or IN_PROGRESS if supported)
   - Optionally mark a step as “SKIPPED” (only if product agrees; acceptable to defer)
2) Must be tenant-scoped and include:
   - Tenant/org identifier
   - Operator identity (who did it)
   - Timestamp
   - Reason (free text; required)
   - Optional link to the support ticket key (SUP-xxxxx) and/or customer escalation thread
3) Audit + safety requirements:
   - Every override must be written to an immutable audit trail (who/what/when/reason).
   - Overrides must not delete raw onboarding events; they should apply as an additional layer (override state) so we can still debug instrumentation.
   - Overrides should be permission-gated (Support/CS + a small set of console/platform admins). No customer-visible ability.
   - Provide a way to revert an override (e.g., “clear override and return to computed state”).
4) UX/API surface:
   - Prefer an internal Console “Support tools” panel on the tenant page OR an internal-only API endpoint that Support can access through existing tooling.
   - Must be usable during a live customer call (low friction, clear confirmation, minimal risk).

Notes / examples where this helps:
- SUP-18421: customer used wrong env var / API key, fixed it, but checklist step remained blocked due to earlier 401s and confusion around which key was used.
- SUP-18488: streaming disconnects; after updating SDK retry settings, Support wants to reset “Streaming established” so the customer can validate the step cleanly.
- SUP-18510: 429 surprise; Support wants to mark “Quotas/Budgets configured” as complete once quotas are set by an admin, without waiting for delayed UI refresh.
- SUP-18544: usage dashboard lag; Support wants to avoid customers thinking they haven’t completed “View usage dashboard” due to known data freshness lag.

Out of scope:
- Bulk edits across multiple tenants
- Automated remediation suggestions
- Customer-facing step editing

Requested by:
- Support enablement as part of onboarding checklist rollout readiness.

Coordination:
- Discussed in #support and with Console team during rollout planning; see notes in #support thread around “macros/triage questions based on checklist state” and request for admin override capability.

Acceptance criteria:
- Support can successfully mark/reset a step for a test tenant in prod with correct RBAC enforcement.
- All actions are logged with operator identity + reason.
- Checklist UI reflects the updated state within <30s.
- We have a documented workflow for Support (where to do it, when to use it, and when NOT to).
comments: 2025-03-13 (Dev Patel): Logging this as an internal helpdesk request for the Console/Platform teams. Without an override we’re going to be blocked on using the checklist as a reliable triage tool during rollout. We already have 3+ cases where a customer did the action but the step didn’t flip due to instrumentation gaps.

2025-03-14 (Chloe Martin): Acknowledged. We can add an admin override layer in the checklist progress service. We’ll need to align on permission model (Support role vs Console admin) and audit log format. Looping in Dylan Brooks + Jada Williams for API shape.

2025-03-15 (Dylan Brooks): Agree on need. Proposal: internal-only endpoints in checklist progress service:
- POST /internal/tenants/{tenant_id}/checklist/{checklist_id}/steps/{step_id}:override (state + reason)
- DELETE /internal/tenants/{tenant_id}/checklist/{checklist_id}/steps/{step_id}:override (clear)
Console will gate behind an internal feature flag + RBAC.
We’ll store overrides separately and compute final state = max(computed, override) with monotonic rules (reset allowed only via explicit reset override).

2025-03-18 (Priya Shah): From support perspective: must support both ‘mark complete’ and ‘reset’. Reset is critical for streaming troubleshooting and for “first successful request” step when the customer wants to validate with a clean run after fixing auth. Also strongly prefer required reason + field for SUP ticket ID.

2025-03-20 (Marcus Lin): Security note: ensure audit log contains operator identifiers but no customer PII beyond tenant/org ID. Retention should match existing admin action logging. Please avoid freeform fields that could accidentally capture secrets; add UI copy warning not to paste API keys/logs into reason.

2025-03-27 (Chloe Martin): Implementing under ENG-5852. Will include:
- RBAC check: internal_support or console_admin
- Required reason (min length) + optional ‘support_case_key’ field
- Immutable audit table + emit internal audit event
Targeting in time for cohort rollout support readiness.
2025-04-03 (Chloe Martin): Shipped in PR-28522 (admin override endpoints + audit logging). Dylan to add Console surface behind internal flag. Support playbook update in progress with Dev + Priya.
2025-04-05 (Dev Patel): Validated in prod with test tenant: can mark ‘API key created’ and reset ‘Streaming established’. Audit entries visible; reason required. Closing.
resolution: Delivered admin override endpoints + audit logging in checklist progress service (PR-28522) and documented usage in support onboarding escalation/triage playbook. Support validated functionality against a test tenant and confirmed it unblocks checklist-based troubleshooting during rollout.
